overview.description: The Kurv Copper & Mining Enhanced Income ETF (KCOP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed, seeking to maximize total returns through exposure to copper and copper mining stocks. The fund gains exposure through derivatives tied to copper and copper-related ETPs and ETFs, as well as through synthetic long positions, which may reach up to 200% of NAV. KCOP was launched on Feb 12, 2026 and is issued by Kurv.
